oauth2.scope: MERCHANT_PROFILE_READ CUSTOMERS_READ CUSTOMERS_WRITE ITEMS_READ ITEMS_WRITE ORDERS_READ ORDERS_WRITE PAYMENTS_READ PAYMENTS_WRITE INVENTORY_READ INVENTORY_WRITE EMPLOYEES_READ

get_merchant.label: Get Business Profile
get_merchant.description: Gets the connected Square business: name, country, currency and main location.

customer_id.label: Customer
customer_id.description: Pick a customer. Type an email to search all customers, or part of a name to search up to the 10,000 newest (the search stops after 20 seconds). For an older customer, search by email or map the Customer ID.

get_catalog_item.label: Get Catalog Item
get_catalog_item.description: Gets a catalog item with its variations and prices.

object_id.label: Item or Variation ID
object_id.description: The catalog item ID, or one of its variation IDs (from Search Catalog Items or an order line item).

update_item_variation_price.label: Update Item Price
update_item_variation_price.description: Changes the price, SKU or name of an item variation.

item.label: Item
item.description: Pick a catalog item. Type to search by name.

variation_id.label: Variation
variation_id.description: The item variation (size, color, ...). Items without options have a single "Regular" variation.

price.label: New Price
price.description: For example 12.50. Leave empty to keep the price.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: Leave empty to keep the current currency.

create_order.label: Create Order
create_order.description: Creates an open order (no payment is taken).

location_id.label: Location
location_id.description: The Square location (store) to use. Leave empty for your main location.

customer_id.label: Customer
customer_id.description: Optional. Type part of a name or email to search.

reference_id.label: Reference ID
reference_id.description: Your own ID for this order, for example from your web shop.

idempotency_key.label: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Optional, up to 45 characters. Leave empty: a retried step returns the same record, but identical calls in one run (such as a loop with the same input) count as one. Set a unique value, like the loop item, to keep them separate.

get_order.label: Get Order
get_order.description: Gets an order with its line items and totals.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: Map it from the New Order trigger or a payment.

get_payment.label: Get Payment
get_payment.description: Gets a payment with its amount, status and card summary.

payment_id.label: Payment ID
payment_id.description: Map it from the New Payment trigger or List Payments.

record_external_payment.label: Record Cash or External Payment
record_external_payment.description: Records money you received outside Square (cash, check, bank transfer, another app). Never charges a card. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: Leave empty to use the location currency.

external_type.label: External Type
external_type.description: For Other payments: how the money was received.

external_source.label: External Source
external_source.description: For Other payments: the provider, for example "Venmo" or "Bank of X".

location_id.label: Location ID
location_id.description: Leave empty to use the main location.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: Optional order this payment pays for.

idempotency_key.label: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Optional, up to 45 characters. Leave empty: a retried step returns the same record, but identical calls in one run (such as a loop with the same input) count as one. Set a unique value, like the loop item, to keep them separate.

refund_payment.label: Refund Payment
refund_payment.description: Refunds all or part of a payment. Card refunds send real money back to the buyer and cannot be undone. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.

payment_id.label: Payment ID
payment_id.description: Map it from the New Payment trigger, Get Payment or List Payments.

amount.label: Amount to Refund
amount.description: Decimal amount in the payment currency, for example 12.50. Must not exceed what is left to refund.

reason.label: Reason
reason.description: Shown to the buyer on the refund receipt.

idempotency_key.label: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Optional, up to 45 characters. Leave empty: a retried step returns the same record, but identical calls in one run (such as a loop with the same input) count as one. Set a unique value, like the loop item, to keep them separate.

get_refund.label: Get Refund
get_refund.description: Gets a refund and its status.

get_customer_by_id.label: Get Customer (by ID)
get_customer_by_id.description: Gets a customer profile by customer ID.

update_item_variation_price_by_id.label: Update Item Price (by ID)
update_item_variation_price_by_id.description: Changes the price, SKU or name of an item variation by variation ID.

variation_id.label: Variation ID
variation_id.description: Item variation ID from Search Catalog Items.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: Leave empty to keep the current currency.
